title: Yumeji Art Museum — official English information

facts.fact: Yumeji Takehisa lived1884–1934 and worked as painter, poet and designer.
Main museum is beside Korakuen in Okayama; birthplace and Shonensanso are separate sites in Setouchi City.
Main opening09:00–17:00,last entry16:30; Monday closure moves to following day after a holiday Monday.
Holiday Monday exception must be retained in both languages.
Museum institution was founded1966; this is not asserted as construction date of the photographed main building.
